newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL JULY IGP-DI INFLATION SLOWS TO 0.09 PCT-FGV.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL JULY IGP-DI INFLATION SLOWS TO 0.09 PCT-FGV.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos-Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 0.09 percent in July, against a 0.70 percent advance in June, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three indices: the IPA wholesale price index, which fell 0.09 percent last month; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.24 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.51 percent.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
